chapter: Army cornet and Bix's Bach horn
title: Difference between a cornet and a trumpet
summary: He explains the cornet is shorter, mellower and sits closer to the body.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Let me ask you something since you mentioned playing hot and what have you. Essentially what is the difference between a cornet and a trumpet?

Very little difference. Both are B Flat instruments in the key of B Flat. And a trumpet is a bit, little longer and the tone is more piercing than a cornet. A cornet is a little shorter and it sort of fits in closer to my body anyway.
My arms and my elbows can hang down closer. Whereas a trumpet is longer and you have to stick, it sticks out a little more.
Now are both of the instruments that you brought today cornets? Or do you have one trumpet and one cornet?
